title: At the café
situation: Ordering drinks and food in a café or restaurant, and paying.

canDo.text: You can order a drink politely.

exercises.why: The thing you order is the object of 'dát si', so it takes the accusative: voda → vodu.

hints.explain: 'voda' is the dictionary (nominative) form. After 'dám si' you need the accusative: vodu.
